questions.quot: Which data type is used to store a single character in C?
questions.explanation: The char type stores a single character such as 'A' or '9'.

questions.quot: What is the output of print(3 * 'ab') in Python?
questions.explanation: Multiplying a string by an integer repeats it that many times.

questions.quot: Which of these is a valid variable name in most programming languages?
questions.explanation: Variable names cannot start with a digit or contain spaces or hyphens in most languages.

questions.quot: What is the worst-case time complexity of quicksort?
questions.explanation: Quicksort degrades to O(n^2) when the pivot is always the smallest or largest element.

questions.quot: Which HTTP status code means 'Not Found'?
questions.explanation: 404 indicates the server could not find the requested resource.

questions.quot: What does the 'final' keyword do to a variable in Java?
questions.explanation: A final variable can be assigned only once and cannot be reassigned.

questions.quot: Which of these is a primary key property in a relational database?
questions.explanation: A primary key uniquely identifies each record and cannot be NULL or duplicated.

questions.quot: What is the purpose of the 'git clone' command?
questions.optionTwo: Copy a remote repository to your local machine
questions.correctAns: Copy a remote repository to your local machine
questions.explanation: git clone downloads a full copy of a remote repository including its history.

questions.quot: In Big-O notation, what does O(1) describe?
questions.optionOne: Constant time regardless of input size
questions.correctAns: Constant time regardless of input size
questions.explanation: O(1) means the operation takes the same time no matter how large the input is.

questions.quot: Which of these is a dynamically typed language?
questions.explanation: Python determines variable types at runtime, so it is dynamically typed.

questions.quot: What does the 'this' keyword refer to inside a class method in Java?
questions.explanation: 'this' refers to the object on which the method was called.

questions.quot: Which of these is NOT a valid HTTP method?
questions.explanation: Standard HTTP methods include GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD and OPTIONS, but not FETCH.

questions.quot: What is the main advantage of using a hash table?
questions.optionTwo: Average O(1) lookup, insert and delete
questions.correctAns: Average O(1) lookup, insert and delete
questions.explanation: Hash tables provide constant-time average performance for key-based operations.

questions.quot: What does JSON stand for?
questions.explanation: JSON is a lightweight text format derived from JavaScript object syntax for data interchange.

questions.quot: Which of these best describes a deadlock?
questions.optionTwo: Two or more processes waiting on each other forever
questions.correctAns: Two or more processes waiting on each other forever
questions.explanation: Deadlock occurs when processes hold resources and wait for resources held by each other.

questions.quot: What is the purpose of the 'JOIN' clause in SQL?
questions.optionOne: To delete rows from a table
questions.optionTwo: To combine rows from two or more tables based on a related column
questions.correctAns: To combine rows from two or more tables based on a related column
questions.explanation: JOIN merges rows from multiple tables using a matching condition between columns.

questions.quot: Which data structure is best for implementing a priority queue?
questions.explanation: A heap supports efficient insertion and extraction of the min or max element in O(log n).

questions.quot: What does the 'static' keyword mean for a method in Java?
questions.optionOne: It belongs to the class rather than an instance
questions.correctAns: It belongs to the class rather than an instance
questions.explanation: Static methods are called on the class itself and do not require an object instance.

questions.quot: Which of these is a correct way to declare a constant in JavaScript (ES6+)?
questions.explanation: const declares a block-scoped variable that cannot be reassigned.

questions.quot: What is the space complexity of a recursive binary search?
questions.explanation: Each recursive call adds a stack frame, and the recursion depth is about log n.
